summary: Surging US Treasury yields driven by hot economic data and weak debt auctions are pressuring broader equities, with mortgage rates crossing 7% and hurting discretionary consumer sectors. While core AI hardware continues to hold market interest, secondary AI infrastructure plays and interest-rate-sensitive stocks face severe valuation contraction. The host advises watching key S&P 500 support between 7650 and 7660 while avoiding premature dip-buying in mortgage and secondary AI plays.
keyPoints: The 10-year US Treasury yield surged to 5.135%, a level unseen since July 2007, driven by strong PMI data indicating an overheating economy.
Market expectations for a Fed rate hike in October spiked to 73%, with increasing pressure for multiple hikes before June next year.
A failed 5-year US Treasury auction, the 11th consecutive weak result, indicates diminishing investor appetite and demands for a higher term premium.
The S&P 500 faces a critical short-term resistance at 7800, with key support sitting between 7650 and 7660.
Loss of the 7650 support level on the S&P 500 would likely trigger a shift toward a hedge-driven selloff and increased market volatility.
Wall Street analysts suggest the market's psychological pain threshold for interest rates has shifted from 5% to a range between 5.5% and 6%.
Despite high yields, short sellers are actively covering positions in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, providing a buffer against aggressive downside.
GameStop is seeing strong bullish signals from heavy insider buying, with the CEO and board members aggressively accumulating shares in September.
Short seller Andrew MacKenzie has taken a significant short position in Micron, Palantir, and the SOXX ETF, betting on supply-demand imbalances in memory.
AI infrastructure secondary stocks (STRL, LGN, SMOD) have suffered severe drawdowns of ~50% as high valuations, previously driven by hype, succumb to physical infrastructure bottlenecks.
The mortgage market is cooling significantly as 30-year rates exceed 7%, severely impacting loan demand and refinancing activity.
Consumer discretionary stocks like McDonald's have entered a technical bear market, signaling that high living costs are curbing consumer spending frequency.

tradeIdeas.action: Hold long bias or range-trade above 7650-7660; cut exposure or hedge aggressively if 7650 breaks
tradeIdeas.rationale: The S&P 500 remains supported by short covering despite rate pressures, holding above positive gamma territory, but a break below key support will shift market makers into a directional hedging mode that sparks downside acceleration.
quotes: “指数目前的关键短期阻力依然是7800点这一道关口。下方支撑呢是7650到7660”

tradeIdeas.action: Buy for a speculative long position tracking insider accumulation
tradeIdeas.rationale: Substantial insider buying from CEO Ryan Cohen ($46.8M in September) and multiple board members provides a strong bullish signal that could precede major company developments.
quotes: “没有什么比公司高管们这个拼命增持，更具有说服力了，吧，所以他们的集体增持也引起了投资者的关注。”

tradeIdeas.action: Keep on watchlist and avoid buying until the macroeconomic rate cycle shifts toward rate cuts
tradeIdeas.rationale: Mortgage lending and housing-related financing companies are severely depressed as 30-year mortgage rates surpass 7% and refinance activity plummets 62% year-over-year, making bottom-fishing premature.
catalysts: Fed pivot toward interest rate cuts
quotes: “这些贷款股只能继续放在观察名单里，等市场从加息预期开始转向下息预期的时候再去配置。”
